product_metadata.title: Plug in Air Purifiers for Home, Mini Odor Eliminator, Ozone Air Deodorizer Freshener for Bedroom Kitchen Bathroom Toilet Garage Pet Odor..
features: 【Plug in Air Purifier】 This corded plug in air purifier (Size: 7.5 inches) can release ozone which has a perfect air purification ability. (Ozone will have a slight unpleasant smell, it's better to leave the room when the purifier is working and open the window). In addition, new houses or new furniture will continuously release TVOC gases year after year, which is harmful to humans, and this air purifier can decompose TVOC gases. Bring back the forest-like fresh air to your room!

【Anion Purifier】 The air purifier can release anion(O-), which can combine with positive ion particles in the air and fall to the ground, reducing the floating particles, such as second-hand smoke, oil smoke, etc. Effectively freshen air and improve sleep quality.

【4 Modes & Automatic Circulation】 The air purifier has 4 kinds of intelligent circulation modes. You don’t need to manually turned on and off frequently. It is suitable for various size of rooms (50-323 square feet) such as: home, kitchen, bathroom, toilet, garage, pet house and also suitable for removing odors such as cigarette smell, kitchen smell, toilet smell and so on.

【Portable Size, Low Noise and Power Saving】 The product size is 7.5" * 4.4" * 1.6", which is very portable. The noise is also very low (only 33dB) and never affect daily life. Besides, this product adopts intelligent power saving and automatic standby technology, it can achieve a ideal deodorizing effect with only a small amount of power.

【Service Guarantee】We provide 12-month 100% warranty. If you are not satisfied with our product, feel free to contact us and we will try our best to make you happy and provide 100% money back guarantee. (During the working process of the machine, it is better to leave the room.)
